name: osric
speaker: Osric
notes: Smith, ex-soldier. Thread 1: Wat's apprenticeship (reads wat_asked; the player's word sets osric_told and osric_decided, 1 = vouched, 2 = called him idle). Thread 2: the battle on the ridge (reads edric_burial / maud_bones, sets osric_battle).

nodes.text: Forge is hot. Mind your sleeves.
Not at the forge now. Sit, or leave. No shop talk.

choices.text: Wat wants to learn the trade.
Edric thinks something's out at the treeline.
Maud says you fought on the ridge.

nodes.text: Only one for a day's walk. Horseshoes, hinges, nails.
Things with edges. Different lord, different war. Now: hinges.
Did he send you? Course he did.

choices.text: He's keen. He'd work hard for you.
Give him a chance. Waiting only makes him lazier.

nodes.text: Keen. He's keen on sleeping till the bell and eating his gran's bread. ...He's in my yard every afternoon, though. Watching. I'll grant him that. Tell him dawn, tomorrow. Late once and he's done.
Aye. That's what I told him. Kind of you to say it plain.
People should mind their own fields.
Eleven years back there was a fight on that ridge. We buried them where they fell, both sides, no priest. Shallow, because we were tired and it was raining. That's all I'll say.
Don't be daft. ...Keep a blade close, all the same.
The door was shut for a reason.
